architecture_summary: Modular React SPA. Pages in src/pages/. Shared UI in src/components/. State: React Context + local component state. Routing: React Router v6. Styling: Tailwind CSS. Data: mock API layer (src/mocks/) until backend ready. Build: Vite. Testing: Vitest + React Testing Library. Lint: ESLint + Prettier. CI: GitHub Actions.

tickets.title: Splash screen page (src/pages/Splash.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch splash screen to React. Static screen. Centered brand logo + name. Auto-redirect to /dashboard after 2s. No user interaction.
acceptance_criteria: Pixel-perfect match to Stitch design
Logo SVG inline or imported (optimize with svgo)
Auto-redirect use setTimeout + React Router navigate
Test: manual check redirect timing

tickets.title: Dashboard home page (src/pages/Dashboard.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch dashboard. Layout: top bar, left sidebar (collapsible), main content grid. Components: summary cards, recent activity list, quick action buttons. Data: mock API (src/mocks/dashboard.js).
acceptance_criteria: Responsive layout (Tailwind grid + flex)
Sidebar toggle persist in localStorage
Cards use shared Card component (src/components/Card.jsx)
Mock data fetch on mount (React Query useQuery)
Test: Vitest snapshot + RTL interaction test

tickets.title: Registration page (src/pages/Register.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch registration form. Fields: name, email, phone, password, confirm password. Validation: client-side (Zod schema). Submit: mock API (src/mocks/auth.js). Success: redirect to /dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Form use react-hook-form + Zod resolver
Password strength meter (zxcvbn)
Email/phone format validation
Submit button disable during loading
Test: Vitest form validation + RTL submit flow

tickets.title: Product catalog event detail page (src/pages/EventDetail.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch event detail. Layout: hero image, event info, description, CTA button. Data: mock API (src/mocks/events.js). Variants: detail_event_katalog_produk_1 and detail_event_katalog_produk_2 (single component, conditional rendering).
acceptance_criteria: Hero image use next/image (optimize)
CTA button state (enabled/disabled) based on event status
Variant switch via URL param (e.g., /events/123?view=variant2)
Test: Vitest snapshot for both variants

tickets.title: Product detail page (src/pages/ProductDetail.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch product detail. Layout: image carousel, product info, price, quantity selector, add to cart button. Data: mock API (src/mocks/products.js).
acceptance_criteria: Image carousel use Embla Carousel (already in package.json)
Quantity selector min/max based on stock
Add to cart dispatch to CartContext
Test: RTL interaction test for carousel + quantity

tickets.title: Exams calendar page (src/pages/ExamsCalendar.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch exams calendar. Layout: month view, day cells, exam events as badges. Data: mock API (src/mocks/exams.js). Interactions: click day to show exam list modal.
acceptance_criteria: Calendar use react-big-calendar (already in package.json)
Modal use shared Modal component (src/components/Modal.jsx)
Events color-coded by subject
Test: Vitest snapshot + RTL click day test

tickets.title: Homework search page (src/pages/HomeworkSearch.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch homework search. Layout: search bar, filters (subject, due date), results list. Data: mock API (src/mocks/homework.js). Interactions: debounced search, filter persistence in URL.
acceptance_criteria: Search use React Query useInfiniteQuery (infinite scroll)
Filters sync with URL search params (React Router useSearchParams)
Results list use shared List component (src/components/List.jsx)
Test: RTL search + filter interaction test

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create app shell. Components: navigation bar (top), sidebar (left), main content area. Routing: React Router v6. Routes: all pages from tickets TASK-001 to TASK-007. Auth: public routes (splash, register), private routes (dashboard, exams, etc.). Layout: responsive (mobile: sidebar collapse to hamburger menu).
acceptance_criteria: Route config in src/routes.jsx (separate file)
Private routes use AuthContext (src/context/AuthContext.jsx)
Navbar: brand logo, user avatar, notifications dropdown
Sidebar: collapsible, items highlight active route
Test: Vitest route matching + RTL navigation test
